 Vivamax after dark? Viva opens VMX Private Club at Newport World Resorts 
 Viva is taking things off-screen and into Manila's nightlife scene!
 November 14, 2026 • 
 1:48 AM 
 Share
 By Bilyonaryo staff 
 Viva is taking things off-screen and into Manila’s nightlife scene!
 The entertainment giant behind Vivamax has opened VMX Private Club at Newport World Resorts in Pasay City, giving partygoers a new spot for late-night entertainment, private gatherings and VIP experiences.
 The club officially opened its doors on Nov. 12, bringing the VMX brand from streaming screens to a real-life nightlife venue.
 Located on the third floor of Newport World Resorts’ Grand Wing, with access through the Portwood Street entrance, VMX Private Club caters to guests looking for a night out with friends or a more intimate celebration.
 And for those who want to keep their night away from the crowd, the club offers VIP private rooms for a little extra privacy.
 Reservations are now open through TableCheck. Guests can also book by calling 0917 110 1898 or emailing [email protected] .
 From streaming to partying, Viva is giving the VMX brand a whole new stage. —Bilyonaryo.com
